---
title: "Policy Work"
---

<p>I write for policymakers and practitioners alongside academic audiences. These briefs and reports translate evidence from field experiments and administrative data into decisions that agencies and nonprofits can act on. Several draw on projects I led in Bangladesh with government and multilateral partners, such as UNDP, the World Bank, the Gates Foundation, USAID, and UKAID.</p>

<script>
(function () {
  var btns = document.querySelectorAll('.filter-btn');
  var entries = document.querySelectorAll('.pub-entry');

  btns.forEach(function (btn) {
    btn.addEventListener('click', function () {
      var filter = this.dataset.filter;

      btns.forEach(function (b) { b.classList.remove('active'); });
      this.classList.add('active');

      entries.forEach(function (entry) {
        var type = entry.dataset.type || '';
        var show = filter === 'all' || type === filter;
        entry.style.display = show ? '' : 'none';
      });
    });
  });
})();
</script>
